acceptanceCriteria.text: A person can delete a Kanban card from the desktop app (e.g. from the card's detail view or menu)
Deleting asks for confirmation before the card is removed
The deleted card disappears from its lane and from list_kanban_cards results, and stays gone after an app restart
A card with a running attempt cannot be deleted, or the app explains what happens to the attempt before deleting
Tests cover the delete path and the running-attempt guard

body: There is no way to delete a Kanban card: the desktop app has no delete action, and the dm CLI / MCP surface has no delete command. Add a delete action to the card in the desktop app so a person can remove a card they no longer want (for example one that was promoted to an epic).
expectedArtifacts: PR merged adding Kanban card deletion to the desktop app, with tests
title: Delete Kanban cards from the app
